title_o: Individual differences in the regulation of intergroup bias: The role of conflict monitoring and neural signals for control.
verdict_reason: repdatalong.csv (osf.io/xdzas; 225 rows, 75 IDs) has ID, HiLoCat, Task and PD; running the audit script's base-R aov reproduces HiLoCat x Task F(1,73)=0.432, p=.513, partial eta2=.006, n=75, matching the table.

data_files.notes: Derived file: process-dissociation (PD) control estimates per participant per task; Weapons has 2 rows per ID (TrialType), Flankers 1
Trial-level raw data present (wc only). Flanker.csv and 'Replication study NO EMAIL ID.csv' have CR line endings (wc 0)
Builds repdatalong from trials; reads Dropbox paths and sources an external 'TH Functions Complete.R' that is not on OSF

key_test.test: mixed ANOVA aov(PD ~ HiLoCat * Task + Error(ID/Task)); key = HiLoCat:Task interaction in the ID:Task stratum

recompute.method: ran the R script's analysis in base R (aov) on the local copy
recompute.result: HiLoCat:Task F(1,73)=0.432, p=.513, partial eta2=.0059, n=75

obstacles: Key test runs on derived PD scores; rebuilding them from trials needs a helper script (TH Functions Complete.R) that is not on OSF
Weapons rows are duplicated per TrialType inside the aov, which the audit accepted; a 'cleaner' reproduction averaging them would differ
